We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have a template (id 29646) that seems to deprotect a TBS group? Actually retro template: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O]-[C:2] meaning forward is protection of alcohol with t-butyldimethylsilyl (TBS). So retro step removes TBS to give free OH and generates TBS group as separate fragment. Applying to target gave three possible precursors (with TBS attached at different OH positions). The product list includes three SMILES strings each with a TBS group attached to one of the OH groups.

We need 5 reactions total. Likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS (retro) to get free alcohol and TBS fragment. 2) maybe HWE or Still-Gennari to form the conjugated diene acid side chain. 3) DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde? Actually target has a carboxylic acid at end (C(O)=O). Could be formed via HWE from aldehyde and phosphonate. So retro step: break C=C double bond formation and carboxylic acid formation? The HWE forms alkene and carboxylic acid? Actually HWE forms alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate, giving alkene and carboxylate (phosphonate becomes ester). The target has a carboxylic acid at end of chain (C(O)=O). That could be from oxidation of aldehyde? Or from HWE using a phosphonate that yields an alkene and a carboxylic acid? The Still-Gennari yields Z-alkene and a carboxylate (phosphonate becomes ester). Might need to convert ester to acid later.

We need to design route with 5 steps: maybe 1) deprotect TBS (retro). 2) remove protecting group? Actually we already deprotected. Next, break the C=C double bond linking side chain to ring? The target has a side chain: /C=C(CO)/C attached to the cyclic sugar? Actually it's a cyclohexane with side chain unsaturated.

We could use HWE to form the diene side chain from an aldehyde and a phosphonate. So retro step: break C=C double bond and form aldehyde and phosphonate. Then DIBAL-H reduces ester to aldehyde? Wait DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde, not needed if we already have aldehyde.

Maybe route: target -> (1) deprotect TBS -> free diol + TBS-OH fragment. (2) retro HWE on the side chain double bond to give aldehyde and phosphonate. (3) DIBAL-H reduction of ester (if present) to aldehyde? Actually target has carboxylic acid; could be derived from ester via hydrolysis later. So retro step: break C-O bond of ester to give alcohol and acid? Not sure.

We need to find templates for HWE and DIBAL-H etc. Let's search for HWE template: functional groups formed C-C double bonds, broken carboxylic esters? Actually HWE forms C-C double bond and breaks C-P and C-O. So we can search for functional_groups_formed ["C-C double bonds"] and functional_groups_broken ["carboxylic esters","C-P"]? Not sure.

Let's search for templates that produce C-C double bonds from aldehyde and phosphonate. Use criteria: functional_groups_formed ["C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_broken ["carboxylic esters"] maybe.
